outcome: binary historical baseline account PNL >0, assigned after holding; never an entry-time feature
method: Within each window only, compute pairwise rank AUC that a random winner has a higher feature than a random loser; compute exact two-sided label-permutation p of the Mann-Whitney U distribution by enumerating all ranks. No numeric thresholds, fitted classifiers, model simulations, or post-selection.
acceptance: After 10 diagnostic comparisons, require same AUC>0.5 or <0.5 direction across train+evaluation and exact p<=0.005 in BOTH windows. All results exploratory on previously seen data, no forward claim and no trading deployment.
